definition_en: a small round piece of medicine, a flat slab with writing on it, or a thin portable computer
core_image: 掌心大小的扁平薄片
scene: 医生把一片白色药片放在桌上，叮嘱她饭后服用。The doctor put a white tablet on the table and told her to take it after meals.
sceneCN: 这里 tablet 是「药片」（第 1 个义项）；句意：医生把一片白色药片放在桌上，叮嘱她饭后服用。

senses.title: A small round pill
senses.definition: a small round piece of medicine that you swallow
senses.definitionCN: 吞服的小圆片药物
senses.example: The doctor put a white tablet on the table.
senses.exampleCN: 医生把一片白色药片放在桌上。
senses.why: A flat pressed disc of medicine keeps the shape of a small board.
senses.whyCN: 压制成型的小药片保留了「扁平一片」的形状，所以从木板转指药片。

senses.title: A flat slab with writing
senses.definition: a flat piece of stone or metal with words cut into it
senses.definitionCN: 刻有文字的扁平石板或金属板
senses.example: The names were cut into a stone tablet.
senses.exampleCN: 名字被刻在石碑上。
senses.why: The oldest sense is a flat board used for writing.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项就是用来书写的平板，石碑与牌匾都沿用了这块「平板」的形象。

senses.title: A thin portable computer
senses.definition: a thin flat computer that you control by touching the screen
senses.definitionCN: 靠触摸屏幕操作的薄型电脑
senses.example: She reads the news on her tablet every morning.
senses.exampleCN: 她每天早上用平板电脑看新闻。
senses.why: The device is literally a flat slate you write and read on.
senses.whyCN: 这种设备本质上就是一块可读可写的扁平石板，于是沿用 tablet 这个名字。

intro.en: Tablet descends from Latin tabula, a board, through a small-board form.
intro.cn: tablet 经由「小板」这一指小形式，源自拉丁语 tabula（木板、书写板）。

items.en: Tabula meant a board or writing tablet.
items.cn: tabula 意为木板或书写板。

items.en: Tabella was the small form of tabula.
items.cn: tabella 是 tabula 的指小形式，意为小板。

items.en: Tablete named a small board.
items.cn: tablete 指小块板子。

items.en: Tablette kept the board sense.
items.cn: tablette 保留了「板」的含义。

items.en: Tablet extended to pills and flat computers.
items.cn: tablet 后来扩展到药片与平板电脑。

note.en: Tablet is set beside look-alike words and beside words for pills and flat devices.
note.cn: 把 tablet 与形近词，以及表示药片和扁平设备的词作对比。

definition_en: to deal with a difficult problem, or to grab and stop an opponent in sport
core_image: 水手把缠成一团的绳索一根根理顺
scene: 甲板上的绳索缠成一团，水手们开始动手处理。The sailors began to tackle the ropes tangled on deck.
sceneCN: 这里 tackle 是「处理、对付」（第 1 个义项）；句意：水手们开始处理甲板上缠成一团的绳索。

senses.title: To deal with a problem
senses.definition: to make a determined effort to deal with something difficult
senses.definitionCN: 下决心应对困难的事情
senses.example: We must tackle the problem before it grows.
senses.exampleCN: 我们必须在问题变大之前处理它。
senses.why: Gear was sorted and set in order before work began, so the verb came to mean setting to work.
senses.whyCN: 先把索具整理归位，再开工；于是这个词从「整理装备」引申为「着手处理」。

senses.title: To grab an opponent
senses.definition: to stop a player by taking hold of them and pulling them down
senses.definitionCN: 抓住对方球员并把他摔倒以阻止进攻
senses.example: The defender tackled the runner at the line.
senses.exampleCN: 防守队员在线上擒抱了跑卫。
senses.why: The physical grip on gear became a physical grip on a rival.
senses.whyCN: 对装备的用力抓握，转成了对对手的用力抓握。

senses.title: Equipment for a sport
senses.definition: the set of equipment used for an activity such as fishing
senses.definitionCN: 某项活动所用的成套装备，如钓具
senses.example: He packed his fishing tackle into the car.
senses.exampleCN: 他把钓具装进车里。
senses.why: The oldest sense is the gear itself.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项就是「装备」本身，动词义由整理装备的动作发展而来。

intro.en: Tackle comes from sailing gear, borrowed from Low German.
intro.cn: tackle 来自航海的索具，借自低地德语。

items.en: Takel named the rigging of a ship.
items.cn: takel 指船上的索具。

items.en: Takel entered English as sailing gear.
items.cn: takel 进入英语，指航海装备。

items.en: Tackle meant to fit out a ship.
items.cn: tackle 表示给船装配索具。

items.en: It came to mean dealing with a task.
items.cn: 它转而表示着手处理任务。

items.en: Sport gave it the sense of grabbing a rival.
items.cn: 体育又赋予它擒抱对手的含义。

note.en: Tackle is compared with look-alike words and with verbs for handling difficulties.
note.cn: 把 tackle 与形近词以及表示应对困难的动词作对比。

sensesIntro.en: Tackle moves from gear, to setting gear in order, to dealing with anything difficult.

definition_en: a small label fixed to something, or to fix such a label
core_image: 行李牌系在箱子的把手上
scene: 她把写有名字的行李牌系在箱子上。She tied a name tag to the handle of her suitcase.
sceneCN: 这里 tag 是「标签」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她把写有名字的行李牌系在行李箱把手上。

senses.title: A small attached label
senses.definition: a small piece of paper or plastic fixed to something to identify it
senses.definitionCN: 系在或贴在物品上用于识别的小纸片或塑料片
senses.example: She tied a name tag to the handle of her suitcase.
senses.exampleCN: 她把姓名牌系在行李箱把手上。
senses.why: The oldest sense is a hanging piece of cloth used as a mark.
senses.whyCN: 最早的义项是垂下来作记号的小布片，今天的标签沿用了这个「挂着的小片」形象。

senses.title: To mark with a label
senses.definition: to attach a label to something or mark it for identification
senses.definitionCN: 给某物贴上标签或加上标识
senses.example: The staff tagged every bag before loading.
senses.exampleCN: 工作人员在装车前给每个包贴上标签。
senses.why: The noun turned into the act of adding the label.
senses.whyCN: 名词直接转化为「加上标签」这个动作。

senses.title: A chasing playground game
senses.definition: a children's game in which one player chases and touches others
senses.definitionCN: 一名儿童追逐并触碰其他人的游戏
senses.example: The children played tag in the yard after school.
senses.exampleCN: 放学后孩子们在院子里玩捉人游戏。
senses.why: Touching a runner marks them, just as a tag marks an object.
senses.whyCN: 碰到跑动的人就算「标记」到他，和给物品贴标签是同一个比喻。

intro.en: Tag first meant a hanging scrap of cloth; its deeper origin is uncertain.
intro.cn: tag 最早指垂下的碎布片，更深层的来源不确定。

items.en: Tagge meant a hanging piece of cloth.

items.en: The playground game borrowed the touch-and-mark idea.

definition_en: the part that sticks out at the back of an animal or object, or to follow someone secretly
core_image: 小狗摇着翘起的尾巴迎接主人
scene: 小狗一见主人回家，立刻摇起尾巴。The little dog wagged its tail as soon as its owner came home.
sceneCN: 这里 tail 是「尾巴」（第 1 个义项）；句意：小狗一见主人回家，立刻摇起尾巴。

senses.title: The back part of an animal
senses.definition: the long part that grows from the back of an animal
senses.definitionCN: 动物身体后部长出的部分
senses.example: The little dog wagged its tail as soon as its owner came home.
senses.exampleCN: 小狗一见主人回家，立刻摇起尾巴。
senses.why: The core sense is the moving appendage at the back.
senses.whyCN: 核心义项就是身体后部会摆动的那一条。

senses.title: The rear end of anything
senses.definition: the last or back part of an object, line, or period
senses.definitionCN: 物体、队伍或时段的最后部分
senses.example: The plane lifted its tail first.
senses.exampleCN: 飞机先抬起机尾。
senses.why: Anything with a front can be imagined with a tail at the back.
senses.whyCN: 凡有前端之物，都可以想象出一条位于后端的「尾巴」。

senses.title: To follow someone secretly
senses.definition: to follow a person quietly in order to watch where they go
senses.definitionCN: 悄悄跟在某人后面，看他去哪里
senses.example: A stranger tailed him through the market.
senses.exampleCN: 一个陌生人在市场里尾随他。
senses.why: To follow at the tail is to stay just behind like a tail.
senses.whyCN: 跟在「尾巴」的位置上，就是像尾巴一样紧贴身后。

intro.en: Tail is an Old English word that has kept its shape for a thousand years.

branches.en: Both point to the back.
The last part of time also has a tail.
branches.cn: 时间段的最后一段也有「尾巴」。

intro.en: Tail builds compounds such as tailwind and taillight.
intro.cn: tail 能构成 tailwind、taillight 等复合词。

latinIntro.en: Tail is Germanic; Latin cauda, tail, appears in caudate and caudal.
latinIntro.cn: tail 属日耳曼语；拉丁语 cauda（尾巴）见于 caudate、caudal。

items.example: The tails of the kites moved.
The tailless cat slept by the fire.
The comet has a long tail.

definition_en: to get hold of something and carry it, to need time, or to choose a way of acting
core_image: 伸手抓起桌上的钥匙
scene: 地铁进站时，他抓起背包冲上车。When the train arrived, he took his bag and jumped on.
sceneCN: 这里 take 是「拿起、抓起」（第 1 个义项）；句意：地铁进站时，他抓起背包冲上车。

senses.title: To get hold of something
senses.definition: to put your hand on something and hold it
senses.definitionCN: 把手放在某物上并握住它
senses.example: He took the keys from the table.
senses.exampleCN: 他从桌上拿起钥匙。
senses.why: The core act is the hand closing on an object.
senses.whyCN: 核心动作就是手掌合拢抓住一件东西。

senses.title: To carry or bring
senses.definition: to carry something or someone to another place
senses.definitionCN: 把某物或某人带到另一个地方
senses.example: Please take this letter to the office.
senses.exampleCN: 请把这封信带到办公室。
senses.why: What is grasped is then carried away.
senses.whyCN: 抓住之后自然就是带走，于是长出「携带」义。

senses.title: To need time
senses.definition: to require a certain amount of time or effort
senses.definitionCN: 需要一定的时间或精力
senses.example: The journey takes two hours.
senses.exampleCN: 这段路程要花两个小时。
senses.why: Time is pictured as something the task takes into its hand.
senses.whyCN: 时间被想象成任务伸手拿走的资源，因此 take 表示花费时间。

senses.title: To choose or accept
senses.definition: to choose a way of acting or to accept an offer
senses.definitionCN: 选择某种做法或接受某个提议
senses.example: She took the job in the end.
senses.exampleCN: 她最后接受了这份工作。
senses.why: Taking an option is mentally grasping it.
senses.whyCN: 把某个选项「抓到手里」，就是采取或接受它。

intro.en: Take came from Old Norse and pushed aside the native word in everyday use.
intro.cn: take 来自古诺斯语，在日常使用中取代了本土词。

items.en: Taka meant to grasp or seize.
items.cn: taka 意为抓住、夺取。

items.en: Tacan was borrowed from Norse.
items.cn: tacan 借自诺斯语。

items.en: Taken became the common verb for grasping.
items.cn: taken 成为表示抓取的常用动词。

items.en: Take spread to carrying, time, and choices.
items.cn: take 扩展到携带、耗时与选择。

items.en: The noun means a filmed shot or money received.
items.cn: 名词义指拍摄的镜头或收到的钱。

note.en: Take is compared with look-alike words and with verbs of grasping and carrying.
note.cn: 把 take 与形近词以及表示抓取和携带的动词作对比。

normalIntro.en: Take is the hand closing on something, then moving it, using it, or choosing it.
normalIntro.cn: take 是手合拢抓住东西，然后带走、耗用或选中它。

normal.en: He took the keys from the table.
normal.cn: 他从桌上拿起钥匙。

normal.en: Please take this letter to the office.
normal.cn: 请把这封信带到办公室。

normal.en: The journey takes two hours.
normal.cn: 这段路程要花两个小时。

normal.en: She took the job in the end.
normal.cn: 她最后接受了这份工作。

normal.en: Take care of your health.
normal.cn: 照顾好你的健康。

abstract.en: Every choice begins with a hand reaching out.
abstract.cn: 每个选择都从伸出手开始。

abstract.en: Time is taken as if it were an object.
abstract.cn: 时间像物品一样被「拿走」。

abstract.en: To take is to make something yours for a while.
abstract.cn: 拿取，就是让某物暂时属于你。

examples.en: He took the keys from the table.
examples.cn: 他从桌上拿起钥匙。

examples.en: The journey takes two hours.
examples.cn: 这段路程要花两个小时。

examples.en: Please take this letter to the office.
examples.cn: 请把这封信带到办公室。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「泰克」——伸手「泰克」一下就把东西拿走，记住中心动作是抓取。

root: 古诺斯语 taka（抓住、夺取）经古英语 tacan 进入英语，取代了本土的 niman。

sensesIntro.en: Take starts from grasping and branches into carrying, spending time, and choosing.
sensesIntro.cn: take 从抓取出发，分叉出携带、耗费时间与做出选择。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand closing on an object and lifting it.
core.cn: 核心意象：手合拢抓住物体并把它提起。

branches.en: Grasping is the starting point.
branches.cn: 抓取是全部义项的起点。

branches.en: Carrying follows grasping.
Time is taken like an object.
branches.cn: 时间像物品一样被拿走。

branches.en: An option is grasped mentally.
branches.cn: 选项是在心里被抓住的。

branches.en: Hand and journey join in one verb.
branches.cn: 手与行程在同一个动词里汇合。

intro.en: Take works mostly through phrases and compounds.
intro.cn: take 主要通过短语和复合词扩展。

latinIntro.en: Take is Norse in origin; Latin capere, to seize, is its distant semantic cousin.
latinIntro.cn: take 源自诺斯语；拉丁语 capere（抓取）是它的远房语义对应词。

definition_en: a natural ability to do something well, or people who have such ability
core_image: 天平一端称出沉甸甸的分量
scene: 教练一眼就看出这个少年身上有天赋。The coach saw at once that the boy had talent.
sceneCN: 这里 talent 是「天赋、才能」（第 1 个义项）；句意：教练一眼就看出这个少年身上有天赋。

senses.title: A natural ability
senses.definition: a natural ability to do something well
senses.definitionCN: 把某件事做好的天生能力
senses.example: The coach saw at once that the boy had talent.
senses.exampleCN: 教练一眼就看出这个少年有天赋。
senses.why: A talent was once a weighed amount of metal, so ability was pictured as something measured out.
senses.whyCN: talent 原指称量出的一笔金属，于是才能被想象成天生「分到」的分量。

senses.title: People with ability
senses.definition: people who are good at something, considered as a group
senses.definitionCN: 被作为一个群体看待的有才干的人
senses.example: The company is looking for young talent.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司在寻找年轻人才。
senses.why: The ability was transferred to the people who carry it.
senses.whyCN: 「才能」这一抽象物被转移到拥有它的人身上。

intro.en: Talent began as a unit of weight and value before it meant a gift.
intro.cn: talent 最初是重量与价值的单位，后来才表示天赋。

items.en: Talanton meant a balance and a weighed sum.
items.cn: talanton 意为天平与称出的数额。

items.en: Talentum kept the sense of a weight of money.
items.cn: talentum 保留了「一笔重量的钱」之义。

items.en: Talenta appeared in biblical parables of entrusted money.
items.cn: talenta 出现在受托钱财的圣经比喻中。

items.en: Talent came to mean a God-given ability.
items.cn: talent 转而表示上天赋予的能力。

items.en: It now means natural ability and able people.
items.cn: 现代英语中指天赋与有才能的人。

note.en: Talent is compared with look-alike forms and with words for ability.
note.cn: 把 talent 与形近形式以及表示能力的词作对比。

entries.definition: the sharp claw of a bird
entries.definitionCN: 猛禽的利爪；只拼写相近，词源不同

normalIntro.en: Talent remembers a scale that once weighed out ability like silver.
normalIntro.cn: talent 记着一架天平，曾像称银子一样称出才能。

normal.en: The boy had talent for music.
normal.cn: 这个男孩有音乐天赋。

normal.en: The company is looking for young talent.
normal.cn: 这家公司在寻找年轻人才。

normal.en: She showed her talent in the school show.
normal.cn: 她在学校演出中展示了才艺。

normal.en: Natural talent still needs daily practice.
normal.cn: 天赋也需要每天练习。

normal.en: The team is full of talent this season.
normal.cn: 这支队伍本赛季人才济济。

abstract.en: Ability arrives as if weighed and handed over.
abstract.cn: 才能仿佛被称量好再交到手里。

abstract.en: A scale became a gift.
abstract.cn: 一架天平变成了礼物。

abstract.en: What is measured out can still grow.
abstract.cn: 被分到的分量仍能继续增长。

examples.en: The coach saw at once that the boy had talent.
examples.cn: 教练一眼就看出这个少年有天赋。

examples.en: The company is looking for young talent.
examples.cn: 这家公司在寻找年轻人才。

examples.en: Natural talent still needs daily practice.
examples.cn: 天赋也需要每天练习。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「太能」——「太能」干的人，就是身上有天赋的人。

root: 希腊语 talanton（天平、称出的重量）经拉丁语 talentum 进入英语，由「一笔钱财」转为「天赋」。

sensesIntro.en: From a weighed sum of money, talent moved to an inborn ability and then to able people.
sensesIntro.cn: 从称出的一笔钱，talent 转向天生的能力，再转向有才能的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pair of scales weighing out a share.
core.cn: 核心意象：一架天平称出一份分量。

branches.en: Ability inherits the image of a measured share.
branches.cn: 才能继承了「分得的一份」这一形象。

branches.en: The gift stands for the gifted.
One word holds both the gift and its bearers.
branches.cn: 一个词同时容纳天赋与拥有者。

branches.en: The scale suggests something given, not earned.
branches.cn: 天平暗示才能是被赋予而非赚来的。

branches.en: A pool of talent is a pool of people.
branches.cn: 人才储备就是一群人的储备。

intro.en: Talent has a tight family of adjectives and a vivid root history.
intro.cn: talent 有一个紧凑的形容词词族和生动的词根史。

latinIntro.en: Latin talentum, from Greek talanton, means a balance and a weighed sum.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 talentum（源自希腊语 talanton）意为天平与称出的数额。

items.exampleCN: 这个角色并非没有才能。

items.example: Talentum meant a sum of money.

latinEntries.example: Talentum meant a sum of money.

definition_en: to speak to someone, or a conversation or a speech on a subject
core_image: 两个人在街角站着说话
scene: 两个老朋友在街角站着聊了很久。The two old friends stood at the corner and talked for a long time.
sceneCN: 这里 talk 是「交谈、说话」（第 1 个义项）；句意：两个老朋友在街角站着聊了很久。

senses.title: To speak with someone
senses.definition: to speak to another person in an informal way
senses.definitionCN: 以轻松的方式对另一个人说话
senses.example: The two old friends talked for a long time.
senses.exampleCN: 两个老朋友聊了很久。
senses.why: The verb comes from the same family as tale and tell, the act of putting words between people.
senses.whyCN: 这个词与 tale、tell 同族，核心是人与人之间交换话语。

senses.title: A lecture on a subject
senses.definition: a speech given to an audience about a topic
senses.definitionCN: 就某个题目对听众所作的演讲
senses.example: She gave a talk on climate change.
senses.exampleCN: 她作了一场关于气候变化的讲座。
senses.why: A talk is one voice speaking at length to many.
senses.whyCN: talk 也指一个声音对着许多人长时间讲述。

senses.title: Formal discussions
senses.definition: official discussions between groups or governments
senses.definitionCN: 团体或政府之间的正式商谈
senses.example: The two sides held talks in the capital.
senses.exampleCN: 双方在首都举行了会谈。
senses.why: Conversation becomes diplomacy when it is formal and repeated.
senses.whyCN: 谈话一旦正式并且反复进行，就成了外交层面的「会谈」。

intro.en: Talk is a Middle English verb tied to tale and tell.
intro.cn: talk 是中古英语动词，与 tale、tell 同源。

items.en: The root meant to recount or tell.
items.cn: 词根意为讲述、叙说。

items.en: Tale meant a story or account.
items.cn: tale 意为故事或叙述。

items.en: Talken meant to speak or converse.
items.cn: talken 意为说话、交谈。

items.en: Talk covered both chat and formal discussion.
items.cn: talk 兼顾闲聊与正式商谈。

items.en: The noun added lectures and negotiations.
items.cn: 名词义又扩展出讲座与谈判。

note.en: Talk is set beside look-alike words and beside verbs of speaking.
note.cn: 把 talk 与形近词以及表示说话的动词作对比。

entries.definitionCN: 行走；只拼写相近，词源不同

normalIntro.en: Talk belongs to the tale-and-tell family, where words pass between people.
normalIntro.cn: talk 属于 tale 与 tell 的词族，话语在人与人之间传递。

normal.en: The two old friends talked for a long time.
normal.cn: 两个老朋友聊了很久。

normal.en: She gave a talk on climate change.
normal.cn: 她作了一场关于气候变化的讲座。

normal.en: The two sides held talks in the capital.
normal.cn: 双方在首都举行了会谈。

normal.en: Let us talk it over before deciding.
normal.cn: 决定之前我们再商量一下。

normal.en: He is a quiet man who rarely talks.
normal.cn: 他话少，很少交谈。

abstract.en: Talk is a bridge built from words.
abstract.cn: 交谈是用话语搭起的桥。

abstract.en: One voice to many becomes a lecture.
abstract.cn: 一个声音对着众人，就成了讲座。

abstract.en: Repeated talk hardens into negotiation.
abstract.cn: 反复的谈话会固化成谈判。

examples.en: The two old friends stood at the corner and talked for a long time.
examples.cn: 两个老朋友在街角站着聊了很久。

examples.en: She gave a talk on climate change.
examples.cn: 她作了一场关于气候变化的讲座。

examples.en: The two sides held talks in the capital.
examples.cn: 双方在首都举行了会谈。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「掏客」——把心里的话掏给客人听，就是交谈。

root: 中古英语 talken 与 tale（故事）、tell（讲述）同源，核心是「用话语叙述」。

sensesIntro.en: Talk runs from private conversation to public lecture to official negotiation.
sensesIntro.cn: talk 从私下交谈，延伸到公开讲座与正式谈判。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two people trading words at a corner.
core.cn: 核心意象：两个人在街角交换话语。

branches.en: Conversation is the everyday branch.
A lecture is talk before an audience.
Official talk becomes negotiation.
Both are voices exchanging meaning.
branches.cn: 两者都是交换意义的声音。

branches.en: Public and formal speech share a stage.
branches.cn: 公开与正式言说共享同一个舞台。

intro.en: Talk extends through -er, -ative, and compounds.
intro.cn: talk 通过 -er、-ative 与复合词扩展。

latinIntro.en: Talk is Germanic; Latin loqui, to speak, is a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: talk 属日耳曼语；拉丁语 loqui（说话）是语义对应词。

definition_zh: 高的；高大的；难以置信的
definition_en: having a greater height than usual, or hard to believe
core_image: 篮球场上最高的少年伸手够到篮筐
scene: 球场上最高的男孩不用跳就够到了篮筐。The tallest boy on the court reached the basket without jumping.
sceneCN: 这里 tall 是「高的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：球场上最高的男孩不用跳就够到了篮筐。

senses.title: Of great height
senses.definition: having a greater height than is usual for a person or thing
senses.definitionCN: 高度超过一般人、一般物的
senses.example: The tallest boy on the court reached the basket without jumping.
senses.exampleCN: 球场上最高的男孩不用跳就够到了篮筐。
senses.why: The older sense was brave and fine, and height came to stand for that dignity.
senses.whyCN: 较早的义项是「勇敢、出色」，身材的高大便成了这种气度的象征。

senses.title: Hard to believe
senses.definition: difficult to believe because it is exaggerated
senses.definitionCN: 因为夸张而难以让人相信的
senses.example: He told a tall story about catching a fish as big as a boat.
senses.exampleCN: 他讲了一个荒诞的故事，说他钓到一条船那么大的鱼。
senses.why: A tall tale is a story that stands too high to be true.
senses.whyCN: 「高得离谱的故事」即高到不可能是真的，于是 tall 表示夸张、难信。

intro.en: Tall first meant swift and brave, and only later meant high.
intro.cn: tall 最初意为敏捷、勇敢，后来才表示高。

items.en: Getæl meant swift and ready.
items.cn: getæl 意为敏捷、利落。

items.en: Tall meant brave, fine, and handsome.
items.cn: tall 意为勇敢、出色、俊美。

items.en: Tall shifted to the sense of height.
items.cn: tall 转向表示身高。

items.en: Tall spread to buildings and trees.
items.cn: tall 扩展到建筑与树木。

items.en: A tall story means an exaggerated one.
items.cn: tall story 指夸张难信的故事。

note.en: Tall is compared with look-alike words and with adjectives of height.
note.cn: 把 tall 与形近词以及表示高度的形容词作对比。

entries.definition: the back part of an animal

落下；只拼写相近，词源不同

normalIntro.en: Tall once praised a brave person, then came to praise a tall body.
normalIntro.cn: tall 曾用来称赞勇敢的人，后来转去形容高大的身材。

normal.en: The tallest boy reached the basket easily.
normal.cn: 最高的男孩轻松够到篮筐。

normal.en: That tall building blocks the sun.
normal.cn: 那座高楼挡住了阳光。

normal.en: He likes to tell tall stories.
normal.cn: 他喜欢讲荒诞的故事。

normal.en: Stand tall when you face a crowd.
normal.cn: 面对人群时要昂首挺立。

normal.en: The tree is taller than the wall.
normal.cn: 这棵树比墙还高。

abstract.en: Height was once a picture of courage.
abstract.cn: 高度一度是勇气的图像。

abstract.en: A story too tall to stand is hard to believe.
abstract.cn: 高得立不住的故事自然难以相信。

abstract.en: Tall measures the body and the tale.
abstract.cn: tall 既量身材，也量故事。

examples.en: The tallest boy on the court reached the basket without jumping.
examples.cn: 球场上最高的男孩不用跳就够到了篮筐。

examples.en: He told a tall story about catching a fish as big as a boat.
examples.cn: 他讲了一个荒诞的故事，说他钓到一条船那么大的鱼。

examples.en: Stand tall when you face a crowd.
examples.cn: 面对人群时要昂首挺立。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「托高」——把他「托高」一点，人就显得高大了。

root: 古英语 getæl（敏捷、利落）经中古英语 tall（勇敢、俊美）转为表示身高。

sensesIntro.en: Tall moved from praise of a brave person to physical height, then to exaggerated stories.
sensesIntro.cn: tall 从称赞勇敢的人，转到身体高度，再转到夸张的故事。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a figure standing above the crowd.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个高出人群的身影。

branches.en: Height is the modern everyday sense.
branches.cn: 高度是今天的日常义项。

branches.en: An exaggerated story stands too high.
Both use height as a measure.
Standing tall is both body and pride.
branches.cn: 昂首挺立既是身体也是尊严。

branches.en: A tall tale stretches the truth upward.
branches.cn: 荒诞故事把真相往上拉长。

intro.en: Tall is a short adjective with a surprising history.
intro.cn: tall 是个短小的形容词，却有一段出人意料的历史。

latinIntro.en: Tall is native Germanic; Latin altus, high, is its semantic counterpart.
latinIntro.cn: tall 是本土日耳曼词；拉丁语 altus（高）是它的语义对应词。

definition_zh: 驯服的；温顺的；乏味的；驯服
definition_en: not wild and willing to live with people, dull, or to make an animal gentle
core_image: 野马低下头让人系上缰绳
scene: 老人花了整个夏天才驯服那匹野马。The old man spent the whole summer taming the wild horse.
sceneCN: 这里 tame 是「驯服」（第 3 个义项）；句意：老人花了整个夏天才驯服那匹野马。

senses.title: Not wild
senses.definition: used to living with people and not dangerous
senses.definitionCN: 已经习惯与人相处、没有野性的
senses.example: The once wild bird is now tame.

scene: 有人轻轻敲了敲车窗，提醒他绿灯亮了。Someone tapped gently on the car window to remind him the light was green.

senses.title: To hit lightly

senses.exampleCN: 有人轻轻敲了敲车窗。

senses.whyCN: 轻击发出的声音是这个词最古老的内核。

definition_en: a piece of work that must be done, or to give someone a difficult job
core_image: 桌上摊开的清单上划掉一项工作
scene: 老师给每个小组布置了一项任务。The teacher gave each group a task.
sceneCN: 这里 task 是「任务」（第 1 个义项）；句意：老师给每个小组布置了一项任务。

senses.title: A piece of work
senses.definition: a piece of work that has to be done
senses.definitionCN: 必须完成的一项工作
senses.example: The teacher gave each group a task.
senses.exampleCN: 老师给每个小组布置了一项任务。
senses.why: The word came from a tax or duty imposed on someone.
senses.whyCN: 这个词原指摊派到某人身上的税或义务。

senses.title: To give someone a job
senses.definition: to give someone a particular job to do
senses.definitionCN: 把某项工作交给某人去完成
senses.example: The manager tasked her with writing the report.
senses.exampleCN: 经理把写报告的任务交给了她。
senses.why: A task is laid on a person, so the verb means laying the duty down.
senses.whyCN: 任务是被「压」到人身上的，因此动词表示把责任派下去。

intro.en: Task came from a word for a tax or duty laid on people.
intro.cn: task 源自表示「摊派的税与义务」的词。

items.en: Tasca meant a tax or duty.
items.cn: tasca 意为税或义务。

items.en: Tasque carried the sense of an imposed duty.
items.cn: tasque 表示被摊派的义务。

items.en: Task meant a piece of required work.
items.cn: task 意为必须完成的工作。

items.en: Task lost the tax sense and kept the work sense.
items.cn: task 舍弃税务义，保留工作义。

items.en: The verb means to assign work.
items.cn: 动词义为分派工作。

note.en: Task is compared with look-alike words and with words for work.

normal.en: He was taken to task for the delay.

abstract.en: A duty becomes a job on a list.
abstract.cn: 义务变成清单上的一项工作。

abstract.en: A task is a promise with a deadline.
abstract.cn: 任务是有期限的承诺。

abstract.en: Work assigned is work that can be finished.
abstract.cn: 被分派的工作，就是可以被完成的工作。

examples.en: A task force was sent to the site.
examples.cn: 一支特别工作组被派往现场。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「他斯克」——「他」必须在天黑前「斯克」服这一堆活，就是任务。

root: 中世纪拉丁语 tasca（税、义务）经古法语 tasque 进入英语，由「摊派的义务」转为「任务」。

sensesIntro.en: Task began as an imposed duty and settled into a piece of work and the act of assigning it.
sensesIntro.cn: task 从被摊派的义务，固定为一项工作，以及分派工作的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a duty pinned to a desk.
core.cn: 核心意象：一份被钉在桌上的义务。

branches.en: The work itself is the main sense.
Assigning is laying the duty down.
Noun and verb mirror each other.

branches.cn: 特别工作组就是为一项任务而设。

intro.en: Task extends through compounds and inflection.

latinIntro.en: Task traces to Medieval Latin tasca, a tax or duty.

definition_en: the flavour of food, the ability to judge what is good, or to try food with the tongue
core_image: 舌尖刚碰到一勺热汤
scene: 她尝了一口汤，觉得有点咸。She tasted the soup and found it a little salty.
sceneCN: 这里 taste 是「品尝」（第 2 个义项）；句意：她尝了一口汤，觉得有点咸。

senses.title: The flavour of food
senses.definition: the flavour that food or drink has in the mouth
senses.definitionCN: 食物或饮料在口中呈现的滋味
senses.example: The soup has a strong taste of garlic.
senses.exampleCN: 这汤有很浓的蒜味。
senses.why: The core sense is what the tongue reports about food.
senses.whyCN: 核心义项是舌头对食物作出的报告。

senses.title: To try food
senses.definition: to put food or drink in the mouth to find out its flavour
senses.definitionCN: 把食物或饮料放入口中以辨别滋味
senses.example: She tasted the soup and found it a little salty.
senses.exampleCN: 她尝了一口汤，觉得有点咸。
senses.why: The noun became the act of testing flavour.
senses.whyCN: 名词转成了检验滋味的动作。

senses.title: Good judgment of style
senses.definition: the ability to judge what is beautiful or suitable
senses.definitionCN: 判断美与得体的能力
senses.example: Her taste in music is very wide.
senses.exampleCN: 她在音乐上的品味很广。
senses.why: Judging flavour by the tongue became judging quality by the mind.
senses.whyCN: 用舌头判断滋味，扩展为用头脑判断品质。

senses.title: A small experience of something
senses.definition: a short experience that shows what something is like
senses.definitionCN: 让人了解某事滋味的短暂经历
senses.example: He had a taste of success at nineteen.
senses.exampleCN: 他十九岁时初尝成功的滋味。
senses.why: A taste is a small sample, and an experience can be sampled too.
senses.whyCN: 品尝本就是取一小口，人生经历也可以「取一小口」。

intro.en: Taste came from a word meaning to touch and test, not only to eat.
intro.cn: taste 源自「触摸、检验」之词，最初并不只与吃有关。

items.en: Taxare meant to touch sharply and judge.
items.cn: taxare 意为触击并评判。

items.en: Taster meant to touch and try.
items.cn: taster 意为触摸并试验。

items.en: Tasten meant to try food in the mouth.
items.cn: tasten 意为在口中试食物。

items.en: Taste extended to judgment of style.
items.cn: taste 扩展到对风格的判断。

items.en: It also means a small experience.
items.cn: 它还表示短暂的体验。

note.en: Taste is compared with look-alike words and with words for flavour and preference.
note.cn: 把 taste 与形近词以及表示滋味和偏好的词作对比。

normalIntro.en: Taste began with touching and testing, then settled on the tongue.
normalIntro.cn: taste 从触摸与检验开始，最后落在舌头上。

normal.cn: 她尝了汤，觉得有点咸。

abstract.en: Tasting is testing with the tongue.
abstract.cn: 品尝就是用舌头检验。

abstract.cn: 品味是头脑评判的风味。

abstract.en: A small taste can teach a whole life.
abstract.cn: 一小口滋味能教会整个人生。

examples.cn: 她尝了一口汤，觉得有点咸。

examples.cn: 这汤有很浓的蒜味。

examples.en: Her taste in music is very wide.

root: 拉丁语 taxare（触击、评判）经古法语 taster（触摸、试验）进入英语，由「检验」转为「品尝」。

sensesIntro.en: Taste moves from testing by touch to flavour on the tongue, then to judgment and brief experience.
sensesIntro.cn: taste 从触摸检验，到舌尖滋味，再到判断力与短暂体验。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tongue meeting the edge of a spoon.

branches.en: Flavour is the everyday sense.

intro.en: Taste builds -y, -ful, and -less adjectives.

definition_en: money that people must pay to the government, or to make someone pay or work hard
core_image: 账本上一行被划走的分量
scene: 市里提高了停车税，车主们纷纷抱怨。The city raised the tax on parking, and drivers complained.
sceneCN: 这里 tax 是「税」（第 1 个义项）；句意：市里提高了停车税，车主们纷纷抱怨。

senses.title: Money paid to the state
senses.definition: money that people or businesses must pay to the government
senses.definitionCN: 个人或企业必须向政府缴纳的钱
senses.example: The city raised the tax on parking.
senses.exampleCN: 市里提高了停车税。
senses.why: The root meant to assess and rate a value, and the assessed sum became the tax.
senses.whyCN: 词根意为评估、核定价值，被核定出的那一笔钱就成了税。

senses.title: To impose a tax
senses.definition: to make someone pay a tax on something
senses.definitionCN: 要求某人为某物缴税
senses.example: The government taxed tobacco heavily.
senses.exampleCN: 政府对烟草课以重税。
senses.why: Assessing a value led to the act of charging it.
senses.whyCN: 核定价值这一动作，发展成实际征收。

senses.title: To put a strain on someone
senses.definition: to make heavy demands on someone's strength or patience
senses.definitionCN: 对某人的体力或耐心提出很高要求
senses.example: The long journey taxed his patience.
senses.exampleCN: 漫长的旅程考验了他的耐心。
senses.why: A tax takes a share of what you have, just as strain takes a share of your strength.
senses.whyCN: 税拿走你的一部分钱财，正如负担拿走你的一部分力气。

intro.en: Tax goes back to a Latin verb meaning to assess or appraise.
intro.cn: tax 可追溯到拉丁语中表示「评估、核定」的动词。

items.en: Taxare meant to assess and appraise.
items.cn: taxare 意为评估、核定。

items.en: Taxa meant an assessed charge.
items.cn: taxa 意为核定出的费用。

items.en: Taxer meant to charge or blame.
items.cn: taxer 意为征收或指责。

items.en: Tax meant a sum demanded by a ruler.
items.cn: tax 指统治者要求缴纳的款项。

items.en: Tax extended to strain and to blame.
items.cn: tax 扩展到「使负累」与「指责」。

note.en: Tax is compared with look-alike words and with words for charges and burdens.
note.cn: 把 tax 与形近词以及表示费用与负担的词作对比。

intro.en: Tax builds taxation, taxable, and taxpayer.
intro.cn: tax 构成 taxation、taxable、taxpayer。

definition_en: a car with a driver that you pay to take you somewhere, or to move slowly on the ground
core_image: 街边一辆亮着顶灯的黄色小车
scene: 他招手叫了一辆出租车，赶去机场。He waved down a taxi and hurried to the airport.

senses.title: A car you pay to ride in
senses.definition: a car with a driver who takes you where you want for a fare
senses.definitionCN: 由司机驾驶、按里程收费送你到目的地的车
senses.example: He waved down a taxi and hurried to the airport.
senses.exampleCN: 他招手叫了一辆出租车，赶去机场。
senses.why: The name came from the fare meter fixed inside the car.
senses.whyCN: 这个名字来自装在车里的计价器。

senses.title: To move slowly on the ground

senses.exampleCN: 飞机缓缓滑向跑道。
senses.why: A taxi rolls at low speed on the ground, much like a taxi car creeping through traffic.
senses.whyCN: 飞机在地面低速滚动，很像出租车在车流中缓慢挪动。

intro.en: Taxi is a shortened form of taxicab, named after the fare meter.

items.en: Taxis meant order, and metron meant measure.

items.en: Taximètre named a device that measured fares.

items.en: Taxicab named the car that carried such a meter.

items.en: Taxi became the everyday short form.

note.en: Taxi is compared with look-alike words and with words for hired cars.

normal.en: The fare on the meter was fair.

abstract.en: A short name can travel far.
abstract.cn: 简短的名字能走得很远。

examples.en: He waved down a taxi and hurried to the airport.
examples.cn: 他招手叫了一辆出租车，赶去机场。

examples.en: The plane taxied slowly to the runway.
examples.cn: 飞机缓缓滑向跑道。

examples.en: The taxi driver knew every short cut.
examples.cn: 出租车司机熟悉每条近路。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「他可惜」——赶时间的人「他可惜」没早点叫车，只好拦下一辆出租。

root: 由希腊语 taxis（次序）与 metron（度量）构成法语 taximètre（计价器），再缩略为 taxicab 与 taxi。

sensesIntro.en: Taxi names the metered car first, then borrows the slow ground roll of an aircraft.
sensesIntro.cn: taxi 先指装表的车，再借指飞机在地面的低速滑行。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small car with a glowing roof sign.
core.cn: 核心意象：一辆车顶亮着灯的小车。

branches.en: The metered car is the main sense.
An aircraft rolls like a car in traffic.
branches.cn: 飞机像车流中的车一样挪动。

branches.en: Both move slowly at the start.
The meter explains the name.
branches.cn: 计价器解释了名字的来源。

branches.en: Ground travel is the shared idea.

intro.en: Taxi appears in compounds such as taxicab and taximeter.
intro.cn: taxi 出现在 taxicab、taximeter 等复合词中。

latinIntro.en: Taxi goes back to Greek roots through French, not to Latin.
latinIntro.cn: taxi 经法语上溯希腊语词根，而非拉丁语。

definition_en: a hot drink made from dried leaves, the leaves themselves, or an afternoon meal
core_image: 白瓷杯里浮着几片舒展的茶叶
scene: 她给客人倒了一杯热茶。She poured a cup of hot tea for her guest.
sceneCN: 这里 tea 是「茶」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她给客人倒了一杯热茶。

senses.title: A hot drink from leaves
senses.definition: a hot drink made by pouring water over dried leaves
senses.definitionCN: 用热水冲泡干叶制成的热饮
senses.example: She poured a cup of hot tea for her guest.
senses.exampleCN: 她给客人倒了一杯热茶。
senses.why: The drink is the first meaning the word carried into English.
senses.whyCN: 这个词进入英语时，最先指的就是这种饮料。

senses.title: The dried leaves
senses.definition: the dried leaves used to make the drink
senses.definitionCN: 用来冲泡饮料的干叶
senses.example: This tea comes from the hills in the south.
senses.exampleCN: 这种茶叶来自南方的丘陵。
senses.why: The material took the name of the drink it makes.
senses.whyCN: 原料沿用了它泡出的饮料之名。

senses.title: An afternoon meal
senses.definition: a light meal eaten in the late afternoon, often with tea
senses.definitionCN: 傍晚时分进食的便餐，常配茶
senses.example: They invited us to tea on Sunday.
senses.exampleCN: 他们请我们周日去喝下午茶。
senses.why: The drink gave its name to the meal served with it.
senses.whyCN: 饮料把名字给了与它一同上桌的那顿饭。

intro.en: Tea travelled from China to Europe through Dutch traders.
intro.cn: tea 经由荷兰商人从中国传到欧洲。

items.en: The word came from a southern Chinese form for tea.
items.cn: 这个词来自中国南方表示茶的读音。

items.en: Dutch thee named the imported leaf.
items.cn: 荷兰语 thee 指进口的茶叶。

items.en: Tea entered English as a luxury drink.
items.cn: tea 作为奢侈饮品进入英语。

items.en: Tea extended to the leaves themselves.
items.cn: tea 扩展到指茶叶本身。

items.en: Tea also named the afternoon meal.
items.cn: tea 又指下午的那顿饭。

note.en: Tea is compared with look-alike words and with other drinks.
note.cn: 把 tea 与形近词以及其他饮料名作对比。

团队；只拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a drink made by steeping herbs

normalIntro.en: Tea is a leaf, a drink, and a meal, all under one short word.
normalIntro.cn: tea 是一片叶子、一杯饮料，也是一顿饭。

normal.en: She poured a cup of hot tea.
normal.cn: 她倒了一杯热茶。

normal.en: This tea comes from the southern hills.
normal.cn: 这种茶叶来自南方丘陵。

normal.en: They invited us to tea on Sunday.
normal.cn: 他们请我们周日喝下午茶。

normal.en: Green tea is popular here.
normal.cn: 绿茶在这里很受欢迎。

normal.en: Let us take a tea break.
normal.cn: 我们休息一下喝杯茶。

abstract.en: A leaf teaches water to become warm and fragrant.
abstract.cn: 一片叶子教水变得温热芬芳。

abstract.en: A drink can name a whole hour of the day.
abstract.cn: 一杯饮料能给一天中的一段时间命名。

abstract.en: One syllable crossed oceans.
abstract.cn: 一个音节越过了大洋。

examples.en: She poured a cup of hot tea for her guest.
examples.cn: 她给客人倒了一杯热茶。

examples.en: This tea comes from the hills in the south.
examples.cn: 这种茶叶来自南方的丘陵。

examples.en: They invited us to tea on Sunday.
examples.cn: 他们请我们周日去喝下午茶。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「替」——口渴时这杯热饮「替」你解乏，就是茶。

root: 源自中国南方方言中「茶」的读音，经荷兰语 thee 进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: Tea names the drink, then the leaf, then the meal that goes with it.
sensesIntro.cn: tea 先指饮料，再指茶叶，再指配茶的那顿饭。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a white cup with leaves unfolding inside.
core.cn: 核心意象：白瓷杯里叶片慢慢舒展。

branches.en: The drink is the core sense.
The leaf carries the name too.
The meal is named after the cup.
Cup and hour belong together.
Drink and leaf are one plant.

intro.en: Tea forms compounds such as teapot, teacup, and tearoom.
intro.cn: tea 构成 teapot、teacup、tearoom 等复合词。

latinIntro.en: Tea is a loanword from Chinese, so there is no Latin root.
latinIntro.cn: tea 是汉语借词，没有拉丁词根。

definition_en: to help someone learn something by showing or explaining it
core_image: 老师握着孩子的手写下第一个字
scene: 她教村里的孩子读书写字。She teaches the village children to read and write.
sceneCN: 这里 teach 是「教」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她教村里的孩子读书写字。

senses.title: To help someone learn
senses.definition: to show or explain something so that another person learns it
senses.definitionCN: 通过示范或讲解让别人学会某事
senses.example: She teaches the village children to read and write.
senses.exampleCN: 她教村里的孩子读书写字。
senses.why: The oldest sense is to point something out so that it is seen.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项是「指出来让人看见」，教学由此发展而来。

senses.title: To give lessons in a subject
senses.definition: to work as a teacher of a subject at a school
senses.definitionCN: 在学校担任某门学科的教学工作
senses.example: He teaches history at the high school.
senses.exampleCN: 他在中学教历史。
senses.why: Pointing out facts became the profession of giving lessons.
senses.whyCN: 把知识指给人看，成了一种职业性的授课。

senses.title: To make someone learn a hard lesson
senses.definition: to show someone the results of their actions in a painful way
senses.definitionCN: 用令人难受的方式让人明白行为的后果
senses.example: The loss taught him to check the figures twice.
senses.exampleCN: 这次损失教他学会核对两遍数字。
senses.why: Experience points out a truth in a way that cannot be ignored.
senses.whyCN: 经验把真相指得让人无法忽视，这就是「教训」。

intro.en: Teach is an Old English verb meaning to show or point out.
intro.cn: teach 是古英语动词，意为显示、指出。

items.en: The root meant to show or point.
items.cn: 词根意为显示、指点。

items.en: Tæcan meant to show and instruct.
items.cn: tæcan 意为显示与教导。

items.en: Techen kept the sense of instruction.
items.cn: techen 保留了教学之义。

items.en: Teach covered both schooling and lessons of experience.
items.cn: teach 兼顾学校教育与经验教训。

items.en: The past form taught became irregular by sound change.
items.cn: 过去式 taught 因音变而成为不规则形式。

note.en: Teach is compared with look-alike forms and with verbs of instruction.
note.cn: 把 teach 与形近形式以及表示教学的动词作对比。

entries.definition: to teach over a long period

normalIntro.en: To teach is to point at the world and say, look here.
normalIntro.cn: teach 就是指着世界说：看这里。

normal.en: She teaches the village children to read.
normal.cn: 她教村里的孩子读书。

normal.en: He teaches history at the high school.
normal.cn: 他在中学教历史。

normal.en: The loss taught him to check twice.
normal.cn: 这次损失教他核对两遍。

normal.en: Can you teach me to swim?
normal.cn: 你能教我游泳吗？

normal.en: She taught herself to play the piano.
normal.cn: 她自学了钢琴。

abstract.en: Teaching is pointing, and learning is seeing.
abstract.cn: 教是手指，学是看见。

abstract.en: A hard loss can be the clearest teacher.
abstract.cn: 惨痛的损失往往是最清楚的老师。

abstract.en: What is shown once can last a lifetime.
abstract.cn: 一次示范能受用一生。

examples.en: She teaches the village children to read and write.
examples.cn: 她教村里的孩子读书写字。

examples.en: He teaches history at the high school.
examples.cn: 他在中学教历史。

examples.en: The loss taught him to check the figures twice.
examples.cn: 这次损失教他学会核对两遍数字。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「提取」——老师把知识「提」出来给你，就是教。

root: 古英语 tæcan（显示、指出），源自日耳曼语，核心动作是「指给人看」。

sensesIntro.en: Teach moves from pointing something out to running a class to painful lessons.
sensesIntro.cn: teach 从「指给人看」，到授课，再到令人难受的教训。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand guiding another hand to write.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手握着另一只手写字。

branches.en: Showing is the source sense.
Teaching becomes a profession.
Experience teaches without a classroom.
branches.cn: 经验不需要教室也能教人。

branches.en: Both point knowledge toward a learner.
branches.cn: 两者都把知识指向学习者。

branches.en: Subject and life share one verb.
branches.cn: 学科与人生共用一个动词。

intro.en: Teach gives English teacher and teaching.
intro.cn: teach 衍生出 teacher 与 teaching。

latinIntro.en: Teach is Germanic; Latin docere, to teach, is a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: teach 属日耳曼语；拉丁语 docere（教）是语义对应词。

definition_en: a person whose job is to teach, or someone who shows others how to do something
core_image: 讲台上握着粉笔的人
scene: 老师把作业本一本本发回给学生。The teacher handed the exercise books back to the students one by one.
sceneCN: 这里 teacher 是「教师、老师」（第 1 个义项）；句意：老师把作业本一本本发回给学生。

senses.title: A person who teaches at school
senses.definition: a person whose job is to teach students in a school
senses.definitionCN: 在学校以教学生为职业的人
senses.example: The teacher handed the exercise books back to the students.
senses.exampleCN: 老师把作业本发回给学生。
senses.why: The word is simply the doer of teach, so the job is the first sense.
senses.whyCN: 这个词就是 teach 的施动者，因此「职业」是第一个义项。

senses.title: Anyone who shows others how
senses.definition: a person who teaches a skill or lesson outside a school
senses.definitionCN: 在学校之外传授技能或道理的人
senses.example: Life is a strict teacher.
senses.exampleCN: 生活是一位严厉的老师。
senses.why: Anyone who points something out can be called a teacher, even without a classroom.
senses.whyCN: 只要把道理指给人看，即使没有教室，也可以被称为老师。

intro.en: Teacher is teach plus the old suffix for a person who does something.
intro.cn: teacher 由 teach 加上表示施动者的古老后缀构成。

items.en: Tæcan meant to show and instruct.
items.cn: tæcan 意为显示与教导。

items.en: The suffix -ere named the one who acts.
items.cn: -ere 后缀指做这件事的人。

items.en: Techere named a person who instructs.
items.cn: techere 指从事教导的人。

items.en: Teacher came to mean a school professional.
items.cn: teacher 固定为学校教师。

items.en: It also describes anyone who teaches a lesson.
items.cn: 它也可指任何给人以教益的人。

note.en: Teacher is compared with look-alike forms and with other words for educators.
note.cn: 把 teacher 与形近形式以及表示教育者的词作对比。

entries.definition: a person who teaches a skill

normalIntro.en: A teacher is the person behind the verb teach.
normalIntro.cn: teacher 就是动词 teach 背后的那个人。

normal.en: The teacher handed back the exercise books.
normal.cn: 老师把作业本发回。

normal.en: Our class teacher knows every family.
normal.cn: 我们的班主任认识每个家庭。

normal.en: She is a teacher of English.
normal.cn: 她是一名英语教师。

normal.en: Life is a strict teacher.
normal.cn: 生活是一位严厉的老师。

normal.en: He trained as a music teacher.
normal.cn: 他受过音乐教师的训练。

abstract.en: Every lesson leaves a face behind it.
abstract.cn: 每堂课背后都有一张面孔。

abstract.en: A teacher is a person who points and waits.
abstract.cn: 老师是指一指、然后耐心等待的人。

abstract.en: The suffix turns an action into a life.
abstract.cn: 一个后缀把动作变成了一种人生。

examples.en: The teacher handed the exercise books back to the students one by one.
examples.cn: 老师把作业本一本本发回给学生。

examples.en: She is a teacher of English.
examples.cn: 她是一名英语教师。

examples.en: Life is a strict teacher.
examples.cn: 生活是一位严厉的老师。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「提取者」——把知识提取出来交给学生的人，就是老师。

root: 古英语 tæcan（教）加施动后缀 -ere 构成，字面即「教的人」。

sensesIntro.en: Teacher means the school professional first, then anyone whose example teaches.
sensesIntro.cn: teacher 先指学校职业，再指任何以身示范的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a figure at the board with chalk in hand.
core.cn: 核心意象：黑板前握着粉笔的身影。

branches.en: The school role is the main sense.
Anyone who teaches can bear the name.
branches.cn: 任何育人者都能用这个名字。

branches.en: Both are people who point the way.
The job is defined by the verb.
Life needs no classroom.

intro.en: Teacher is a transparent teach plus -er formation.
intro.cn: teacher 是 teach 加 -er 的透明构词。

latinIntro.en: Teacher is Germanic; Latin magister, master, is the closest Latin parallel.
latinIntro.cn: teacher 属日耳曼语；拉丁语 magister（师长）是最接近的对应词。

items.exampleCN: 他像老师那样点了点头。
教育工作者聚在一起讨论改革。

definition_en: a group of people who play or work together, or to join with someone to do something
core_image: 几匹马被同一副挽具套在一起
scene: 整支球队在雨里坚持训练。The whole team kept training in the rain.
sceneCN: 这里 team 是「队、队伍」（第 1 个义项）；句意：整支球队在雨里坚持训练。

senses.title: A group that plays together
senses.definition: a group of people who play a sport on the same side
senses.definitionCN: 在同一方参加比赛的一个人群
senses.example: The whole team kept training in the rain.
senses.exampleCN: 整支球队在雨里坚持训练。
senses.why: The oldest sense is a set of animals yoked to one load.
senses.whyCN: 最早的义项是被同一副挽具套住、共同拉东西的一组牲口。

senses.title: A group that works together
senses.definition: a group of people who work together on a task
senses.definitionCN: 为完成一项任务而共同工作的一群人
senses.example: A team of engineers designed the bridge.
senses.exampleCN: 一组工程师设计这座桥。
senses.why: The yoked animals became any group pulling one goal.
senses.whyCN: 被套在一起的牲口，变成任何朝同一目标用力的群体。

senses.title: To join with someone
senses.definition: to join another person or group to do something together
senses.definitionCN: 与另一个人或群体联合做事
senses.example: The two firms teamed up on the project.
senses.exampleCN: 两家公司在这个项目上合作。
senses.why: To be in one team is to be yoked to the same task.
senses.whyCN: 在同一个队里，就是被套上同一件差事。

intro.en: Team first meant a set of animals pulling one load.
intro.cn: team 最初指共同拉一副载重的一组牲口。

items.en: The root meant a pulling group.
items.cn: 词根意为共同拖拉的一群。

items.en: Team meant a set of draft animals.
items.cn: team 指一组役畜。

items.en: Team extended to any group with one purpose.
items.cn: team 扩展到任何目标一致的群体。

items.en: Team named sports sides and work groups.
items.cn: team 指运动队与工作组。

items.en: The verb means joining forces.
items.cn: 动词义为合力合作。

note.en: Team is compared with look-alike forms and with words for groups.
note.cn: 把 team 与形近形式以及表示群体的词作对比。

entries.definitionCN: 充满；只拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a working group on a ship

normalIntro.en: Team remembers animals in one harness pulling together.
normalIntro.cn: team 记着一副挽具里共同用力的牲口。

normal.en: The whole team kept training in the rain.
normal.cn: 整支球队在雨里坚持训练。

normal.en: A team of engineers designed the bridge.
normal.cn: 一组工程师设计了这座桥。

normal.en: The two firms teamed up on the project.
normal.cn: 两家公司在这个项目上合作。

normal.en: Team spirit carried them through the season.
normal.cn: 团队精神支撑他们走完赛季。

normal.en: Every team member spoke at the meeting.
normal.cn: 每位团队成员都在会上发言。

abstract.en: One harness turns many bodies into one effort.
abstract.cn: 一副挽具把许多身体变成一次用力。

abstract.en: A team is a promise made of shoulders.
abstract.cn: 团队是用肩膀许下的承诺。

abstract.en: Shared load, shared direction.
abstract.cn: 共同的负担，共同的方向。

examples.en: The whole team kept training in the rain.
examples.cn: 整支球队在雨里坚持训练。

examples.en: A team of engineers designed the bridge.
examples.cn: 一组工程师设计了这座桥。

examples.en: The two firms teamed up on the project.
examples.cn: 两家公司在这个项目上合作。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「替姆」——彼此「替」着分担，才叫一队人。

root: 古英语 team（一组同轭役畜），源自日耳曼语，由「共同拉载重的一群」引申为「团队」。

sensesIntro.en: Team starts with yoked animals, becomes a sports side, a work group, and the act of joining.
sensesIntro.cn: team 从同轭牲口，变成球队、团队，以及合作的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: several horses under one harness.
core.cn: 核心意象：几匹马套在同一副挽具下。

branches.en: The sports side is the daily sense.
Work groups inherit the shared load.
branches.cn: 工作组继承了共同负担。

branches.en: Teaming up is entering one harness.
branches.cn: 合作就是进入同一副挽具。

branches.en: Both pull toward one goal.
branches.cn: 两者都朝同一个目标用力。

branches.en: Group and joining are two sides.
branches.cn: 群体与联合是一体两面。

intro.en: Team builds teammate, teamwork, and teamster.
intro.cn: team 构成 teammate、teamwork、teamster。

latinIntro.en: Team is Germanic; Latin iugum, yoke, names the same image.
latinIntro.cn: team 属日耳曼语；拉丁语 iugum（轭）呈现同一意象。

definition_zh: 技术的；专业的；技术性的
definition_en: relating to machines or applied science, or using the special terms of a field
core_image: 厚厚的说明书上满是术语与示意图
scene: 说明书里全是技术术语，他读得很慢。The manual is full of technical terms, so he reads it slowly.
sceneCN: 这里 technical 是「技术的、专业术语的」（第 2 个义项）；句意：说明书里全是技术术语，他读得很慢。

senses.title: Relating to machines and applied science
senses.definition: connected with machines, engineering, or applied science
senses.definitionCN: 与机器、工程或应用科学有关的
senses.example: The lab needs better technical equipment.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室需要更好的技术设备。
senses.why: The Greek root named a craft or skill, and machines are modern crafts.
senses.whyCN: 希腊词根指技艺、手艺，机器是现代的手艺。

senses.title: Using special terms
senses.definition: using the special words of a particular field
senses.definitionCN: 使用某一领域专门用语的
senses.example: The manual is full of technical terms.
